required.name: APEX_RUNNER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
required.purpose: Mint short-lived one-repository installation tokens for the private control plane and one catalog-approved workload repository per run
minimum_permissions: GitHub App installed on GlacierEQ/llm-runner-teams and approved private workload repositories
required.exposure: actions/create-github-app-token only; never workload environment, public job envelope, artifact, or log

required.name: APEX_RUNNER_APP_CLIENT_ID
required.purpose: Identify the least-privilege APEX public runner GitHub App

required.name: APEX_BRANCH_WRITE_TOKEN
required.purpose: Delete only approval-gated nondefault branch refs after the Master Strand extinction gate proves no unique unintegrated progress remains
minimum_permissions: Metadata: read and Contents: read/write on explicitly selected GlacierEQ repositories
required.exposure: Trusted Master Strand extinction adapter only; never checkout, workload process, public output, or persisted logs

minted_runtime_tokens.name: APEX_CONTROL_TOKEN
minted_runtime_tokens.lifetime: GitHub App installation token; revoked automatically at job completion

minted_runtime_tokens.name: APEX_PRIVATE_READ_TOKEN
minted_runtime_tokens.scope: Exactly one catalog-approved private workload repository
minted_runtime_tokens.lifetime: GitHub App installation token; revoked automatically at job completion

runtime.GITHUB_TOKEN: Public bootstrap repository only; contents read and issues write

rotation.on_suspected_exposure: rotate the GitHub App private key immediately
rotation.on_scope_change: review GitHub App installation repository access and permissions
